description:
Analyzes a multi-day meal plan and assesses its daily average.

Every ingredient is resolved and converted, then totaled by dish, meal,
and day, up to 400 ingredients. The assessment is of the daily average, not
the multi-day sum. per_day has each day's totals, shopping_list totals
ingredients at full recipe quantities, and failed lists ingredients missing
from the totals. The detail breakdown is large for a full week.

days.description: Days, 1-14, each {"day": "Monday", "meals": [{"name": "dinner", "dishes": [...]}]}. A dish is {"name": "Moussaka", "servings": 6, "eaten": 1, "ingredients": [...]}, where servings is the recipe yield and eaten is how many of those servings this person has.

eaten.description: Servings this person eats. Defaults to 1.

fdc_id.description: FoodData Central id, which pins an exact food.

grams.description: Weight in grams, in place of a portion.

portion.description: Portion such as 2 tbsp, 1/2 cup, 1 medium, or 150 g.

detail.description: Include the per-dish, per-ingredient breakdown. Defaults to false.

include_shopping_list.description: Include total ingredient quantities to buy. Defaults to true.

name: analyze_plan
title: Analyze a meal plan
